assessment_objectives.objective: the criteria used to determine when data is no longer in active use and is eligible for archiving are defined.
applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual retention obligations are identified and documented for each type of archived data.
data that is no longer in active use is archived to secure storage and retained for the period required by the identified retention obligations.
archived data is protected from unauthorized access, modification and deletion for the duration of its retention period.
the retrievability of archived data is tested at a defined frequency and the results are documented.
